SSC Junior Engineer JE Online Form 2026 (1748 Posts) – Last Date – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the notification for the post of Junior Engineer JE. This recruitment has been issued for 1748 posts. The online application process for SSC Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 has started on 02 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 22 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SSC Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Online Correction Date : 28-30 September 2026
  • Exam Date Paper I : October / November 2026
  • Exam Date Paper II : December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Correction Fees : Rs. 200/- (First Time)
  • Correction Fees : Rs. 500/- (Second Time)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
